question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing right winger, Dave is playing left midfielder, Eve is playing fullback, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing cheerleader.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Fred trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) striker
(C) right winger
(D) left midfielder
(E) fullback
(F) benchwarmer
(G) cheerleader
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (goalkeeper, striker, right winger, left midfielder, fullback, benchwarmer, cheerleader)
1. Swap Gertrude and Eve: (goalkeeper, striker, right winger, left midfielder, cheerleader, benchwarmer, fullback)
2. Swap Dave and Gertrude: (goalkeeper, striker, right winger, fullback, cheerleader, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
3. Swap Alice and Dave: (fullback, striker, right winger, goalkeeper, cheerleader, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
4. Swap Bob and Claire: (fullback, right winger, striker, goalkeeper, cheerleader, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
5. Swap Claire and Fred: (fullback, right winger, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, cheerleader, striker, left midfielder)
6. Swap Eve and Gertrude: (fullback, right winger, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, left midfielder, striker, cheerleader)
7. Swap Bob and Gertrude: (fullback, cheerleader, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, left midfielder, striker, right winger)
Alice is playing fullback, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
